statement: For any byte string t, say that t is obtainable from s if there are k >= 0 and byte strings s0, s1, ..., sk with s0 = s, sk = t, and for each j < k, s(j+1) is obtained from sj by deleting two adjacent bytes that are either (65,66) or (67,68), then concatenating the part before them with the part after them. The function returns a result r such that, viewing r as an integer, r = min{ len(t) | t is obtainable from s }. Consequently some obtainable t has len(t) = r, and no obtainable t has len(t) < r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 65 <= s[i] <= 90.

statement: For every s satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r and does not fail: there is no panic, no arithmetic overflow, and no out-of-bounds access.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 65 <= s[i] <= 90.

statement: The function returns a result r, and 0 <= r <= len(s).
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 65 <= s[i] <= 90.

statement: The function returns a result r, and len(s) - r is even; equivalently, r and len(s) have the same parity.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 65 <= s[i] <= 90.

statement: The function returns a result r, and for every byte string t obtainable from s by zero or more allowed deletions, if t contains no adjacent pair (65,66) and no adjacent pair (67,68), then len(t) = r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 65 <= s[i] <= 90.

statement: The function returns a result r, and for every byte string t obtained from s by exactly one allowed deletion, the minimum possible length over all byte strings obtainable from t by zero or more allowed deletions is also r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 65 <= s[i] <= 90.

statement: The function returns a result r, and r = len(s) if and only if for every i with 0 <= i < len(s)-1 it is not the case that (s[i] = 65 and s[i+1] = 66) or (s[i] = 67 and s[i+1] = 68).
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 65 <= s[i] <= 90.

statement: The function returns a result r, and r = 0 if and only if there exists a finite sequence of zero or more allowed deletions reducing s to the empty byte string.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 65 <= s[i] <= 90.

statement: Let N be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(s) such that s[i] is not one of 65, 66, 67, 68. Let a = (number of occurrences of 65 in s) - (number of occurrences of 66 in s), and let c = (number of occurrences of 67 in s) - (number of occurrences of 68 in s). The function returns a result r, and r >= N + abs(a) + abs(c).
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 65 <= s[i] <= 90.

statement: The function returns a result r, and for every byte string t obtainable from s by zero or more allowed deletions, the difference (number of occurrences of 65 in t) - (number of occurrences of 66 in t) equals the same difference in s, and the difference (number of occurrences of 67 in t) - (number of occurrences of 68 in t) equals the same difference in s.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 65 <= s[i] <= 90.

statement: The function returns a result r, and for every byte string t obtainable from s by zero or more allowed deletions, every byte of s whose value is not one of 65, 66, 67, 68 occurs in t in the same relative order as in s.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 65 <= s[i] <= 90.

statement: The function returns a result r. For any byte string u formed by inserting the contiguous pair (65,66) or the contiguous pair (67,68) at any position of s, the minimum possible length over all byte strings obtainable from u by zero or more allowed deletions is also r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 65 <= s[i] <= 90.

statement: The function returns a result r, and there exists a finite sequence of exactly (len(s)-r)/2 allowed deletions that starts from s and ends at a byte string t with len(t) = r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(s), 65 <= s[i] <= 90.
